correctness.rationale: The exact generator decomposes into complementary C (constants), P (peripheral pair means centered across pairs), and R, with Q eigenvalues 0,-1/2,-3/2. Thus modulo constants H=bI+(a-b)P with a=e^{-t/2}, b=e^{-3t/2}. Layer-cake decomposition of any signal into nested indicator cuts reduces the projection norm to cuts. Randomly replacing split pairs by full/empty pairs preserves expected cross-pair and hub variation and deletes within-pair variation, so only whole-pair indicators need testing. For r whole pairs their Gini ratio is 2h(m+1)/(m(2h+1)), h=m-r, maximized by r=1, giving c_m=2(m²-1)/(m(2m-1)). The one-full-pair witness aligns signs in the triangle inequality, giving equality for all t. d_m=c_m-1=(m-2)/(m(2m-1)) has its unique maximum 1/14 at m=4; its bound proves strict contraction. Independently enumerated ALL binary cuts for m=1..6 at t=.7: norms match formula to <4e-16. Inspected source verify.py rational spectral and orbit checker. The symbolic cut reduction proves all m and real t.
